title: GraphMAE: Self-Supervised Masked Graph Autoencoders
layout_note: The method runs as one left-to-right row (input graph, encoding stage, decoding stage, reconstructed graph); a long Encoding/Decoding timeline bar runs under the two stage boxes, and below it a faded baseline row (GAEs) repeats the stages box for box, so the figure is a pipeline with an aligned comparison strip.
grouping: Two large black dashed rectangles hold the two stages: the first contains the masking step, the GNN Encoder card and the 'code' matrix; the second contains Re-mask, the GNN Decoder card and the 'Reconstructed Features' matrix. A small dashed title box 'Feature Reconstruction' sits over the final graph. The input graph and the method name 'GraphMAE' stand outside on the left. Beneath the stage boxes a dark-navy long-dash line with dot endpoints carries the words Encoding and Decoding in large bold serif. The bottom row, labelled 'GAEs' and reached by a curved black arrow from the input graph, has three light-grey dashed boxes with grey text (GNN Encoder; MLP or Propagation; - Link Reconstruction / - Feat Recon. with MSE) joined by thin grey arrows, each aligned under its counterpart above.
shapes_depth: Square-cornered, flat shapes with soft grey drop shadows on the graph cards and matrices. The same five-node toy graph recurs at every stage: numbered white circles with thick black outlines and thin grey edges; masked nodes are filled grey and tagged [MASK] or [DMASK], reconstructed nodes are filled light blue. Node features are small three-cell white bars beside the nodes (two-cell bars inside the decoder card). The encoder is a stack of three offset white cards; the decoder is a single card. Matrices are ruled grids: 'code' is two columns by five rows in pale blue, the re-masked copy has rows 2 and 4 grey, the reconstructed features are a white three-by-five grid with z2 and z4 beside their rows. Stage-to-stage connectors are hollow outlined block arrows. All text is a bold serif face; math is italic.
proposed_highlight: The method name 'GraphMAE' is the largest text, bold blue serif and underlined, at the top-left. The method's key operations - Mask Node Features, Re-mask, GNN Decoder and Scaled Cosine Error(z_i, x_i) - are set in the same blue underlined style, while ordinary steps (GNN Encoder, code, Reconstructed Features) stay bold black. The prior approach is pushed back as a grey dashed row with grey text beneath the method.
lesson: Draw the baseline as a faded grey dashed row directly beneath the method row, one box per stage and aligned under its counterpart, so the reader compares stage by stage while the baseline never competes with the method for attention.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2205.10803); venue KDD recorded from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar). The caption states that key operations are underlined; the drawing shows them blue as well. elements 'other' = the dashed Encoding/Decoding timeline bar. The `refs crop` record lists embedded raster regions over the encoder card stack, the decoder card and the matrix cells (drawn parts, not photos), so the measured photo_share counts those parts and the palette leaves them out.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: One left-to-right pipeline of drawn graphs and feature grids: input graph -> masked graph in a GNN Encoder box -> code grid -> re-masked grid -> GNN Decoder graph -> reconstructed features -> output graph scored by Scaled Cosine Error, spanned by an 'Encoding' / 'Decoding' timeline.

relations.form: dashed boxes in one row joined by hollow block arrows, with a dashed timeline underneath labelling the Encoding and Decoding spans

the same five-node graph redrawn at each step, masked nodes 2 and 4 filled grey and tagged [MASK] or [DMASK], node features as small bar glyphs beside nodes, codes and reconstructions as cell grids with re-masked rows grey
the output graph on the right pairs reconstructed z_2, z_4 (blue-filled nodes) with the original x_2, x_4 under 'Scaled Cosine Error(z_i, x_i)'
a greyed GAEs row underneath with the same three-box skeleton (GNN Encoder, MLP or Propagation, link / MSE reconstruction) branching from the input graph as prior work

channels.colour: grey fill = masked node or masked row; pale blue = learned representations (code grid, reconstructed node fills); blue underlined text = the method's own steps; greyed-out text and boxes = prior GAEs
channels.shape: numbered circle = node, bar glyph = node feature, cell grid = representation matrix, card stack = encoder layers
channels.line: hollow block arrows = pipeline steps; dashed rectangles = stage boxes (also used for the prior-work row); dash-dot timeline = phase spans

quality.strengths: The representations are drawn as nouns between stages (code grid, re-masked grid, reconstructed features), masking is drawn on the graph and on the grid rows with one grey code, and the prior GAE pipeline sits underneath in grey with the same skeleton so the differences are located by position.
quality.weaknesses: Grey means both 'masked' and 'prior work' (greyed row); the method's novelties are marked only by blue underlined text rather than by space or fill; the graph is redrawn four times at similar size, so routine steps take as much space as the new re-mask step.

insights.structure: Dashed boxes for GNN Encoder and Re-mask + GNN Decoder sit in a row between the input graph at left and a Feature Reconstruction graph at right, with a dashed timeline below labelling 'Encoding' and 'Decoding' spans, and a greyed GAEs row underneath as contrast.
insights.data: Graphs are drawn as numbered circle nodes with small feature-bar glyphs; masked nodes are grey and tagged [MASK]/[DMASK]; codes and reconstructed features are small grids with grey re-masked rows.
insights.emphasis: The method's own steps (Mask Node Features, Re-mask, GNN Decoder, Scaled Cosine Error) are underlined in blue, while the conventional GAE pipeline below is greyed out to show what is replaced.
insights.flow: Left to right with hollow block arrows between stages; one curved arrow drops from the input graph to the greyed GAE baseline row.
insights.avoid: Blue underlined headings look like hyperlinks, and the stacked-card GNN Encoder box makes nodes partially overlap their own labels.

arrangement.units: one left-to-right pipeline with two dashed sub-boxes (encoder; re-mask+decoder) and a dashed-titled reconstruction target, plus a greyed baseline row beneath
arrangement.inputs_as: a small numbered node graph with feature bars x1-x5
arrangement.losses_at: far right under the reconstructed graph: Scaled Cosine Error(z_i, x_i)
arrangement.shared: a dashed Encoding/Decoding timeline spanning both sub-boxes
